title: Bomberman
statusNote: The card as dumped runs: title, options, the story pages and the pause menu work, and a 1P game reaches Standard World stage 1-1, where the player walks and lays bombs that explode. The second, patched 6R29.APP in the dump ("fix Engage") was not needed.
notes: On the title screen choose with left and right (1P game, VS game, High Score, Options, Exit) and confirm with 5. The OK key does nothing in this game.
Left idle, the title screen starts a demo; any direction key returns to the title.
Either soft key pauses a stage; the pause menu can save and return to the title screen.
VS game needs Bluetooth, which is not available here.

controls.source: Observed in the menus and in play (the game has no controls screen): moving, laying a bomb with 5, the pause menu on the soft keys, 5 and 7 as confirm and back in menus.
notes: Arrows move; Space or Enter is the 5 key (lay a bomb, confirm in menus), Backspace is 7 (back), Q or Escape pauses.
